data.cultural_impact: The name Eeshan holds deep cultural significance in Hindu mythology. Eeshan is a direct derivative of the name of the Hindu Sun God, Surya. This God is considered powerful, generous, and life-sustaining. Worship of the Sun God is an integral part of Hindu culture, and consequently, names derived from the Sun are considered auspicious.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Eeshan emphasizes the inner fiery energy within every being. It calls forth the divine power of transformation, creativity, and the assertion of one's will. Furthermore, it connects the individual to Lord Shiva, a supreme deity representing the transcendental Self, pure consciousness, and the essential recommendation of desires. The name Eeshan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual strength and the cosmic power residing within.

historical_references.reference: Eeshan is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ishana', which means 'Lord of All'. It is one of the many names for Shiva, the god of destruction and transformation in Hinduism. This name is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures, such as the Shiva Purana and the Mahabharata.
